purpose: Learn black-box JavaScript rule induction and counterexample search from automatically verified synthetic curricula.

memory_system.episodic_memory: persistent trace and counterexample store keyed by program, rule family and state signature
memory_system.semantic_memory: versioned Rule IR library with confidence and evidence pointers
memory_system.retrieval: hybrid structured filters plus embedding Top-K
memory_system.policy_training: reinforcement learning for write, retrieve, consolidate and forget actions
memory_system.anti_staleness: black-box version and fingerprint are mandatory memory keys

bootstrap_data.generation: parameterized program mutation plus executable Rule IR verification

training.name: synthetic warm start
training.objective: causal language modeling over JS, game rules, traces and Rule IR

training.name: multi-task supervised tuning
training.objective: rule abstraction, behavior prediction, next query and evidence generation

training.name: active query policy tuning
training.objective: reduce query count while preserving executable counterexample accuracy

training.name: long-term memory policy tuning
training.objective: maximize future rule-recovery utility while penalizing retrieval tokens, stale memories and irrelevant writes

requirements: at least 50M verified episodes or equivalent diversity
MoE routing beats dense baseline in controlled ablation
compute and storage budgets are documented
